aboutText: Based in Campbellfield, Modern Cabinet Maker has over 10 years of experience creating custom cabinetry and joinery solutions across Melbourne. With more than 5,000 projects completed, we specialise in high-quality kitchens, bathrooms, and storage solutions. Our skilled team uses premium materials and backs every project with a 7-year warranty, ensuring durability and tailored designs for your home.
servicesText: We offer a comprehensive range of cabinet making services, including kitchens, bathrooms, laundry, wardrobes, storage, home offices, and TV units. Each project is crafted to your specifications using top-quality materials. Serving Campbellfield and all Melbourne suburbs with dedicated professionalism.
